capturedAgainst: Cloud Run CMS_Agent MCP workspace (live), from the operator's own MCP client
why: W0 of node-default-output: establish, live rather than by reading the source, whether the Workbench's OverrideOutputModal payload reaches the server at all. It does not. The published input schema for this tool was { id?, stage, value } with additionalProperties:false, so the modal's { runId, nodeId, value, note } is rejected before the handler ever runs — and even the workspace form it WOULD have had to use writes to the workspace's own stageOutputs collection, which no workflow run reads (a run reads run.stageOutputs; the only consumer of the workspace collection is nodeRuntime.ts's standalone node_execute path). The override modal was fixture-only.

calls.notes: The pre-W3 server accepted this and only this. Note what it returns: a row in the WORKSPACE stageOutputs collection with its own generated id. No runId, no nodeId, no node state change — nothing that a workflow run would ever read.

calls.error: validation_error: input did not match the tool schema.
calls.errorSource: the tool's own published inputSchema, enforced before dispatch
calls.notes: EXACTLY the payload workbench/src/api/verbs.ts's stageSaveOutput sends (see OverrideOutputModal.tsx). Three unrecognised keys (runId, nodeId, note) and a missing required one (stage). Rejected client-side against the published schema, so the failure never even reached src/agent/mcp/workspace/tools.ts — which is why nothing about it appeared in any server log, and why the modal looked like it was doing something.

expectedAfterW3.rule: exactly one form per call: `stage`, or BOTH `runId` and `nodeId`

run_scoped.writes: run.stageOutputs[nodeId] on that run; node completed, durationMs 0, outputProvenance { source: "operator_override", updatedAt, note? }, node warning output_source:operator_override, nodeId appended to run.defaultedNodeIds
run_scoped.consequence: the run is refused at its publishing tail with gate.publishing.defaulted_upstream unless it is a mock run — content nobody produced never publishes. workflow.retry_node WITHOUT useDefaultOutput undoes the override and makes the run publishable again.
